assessments.reasoning: Printed pp. 44 and 51 distinguish temporary activity state from persistent instance slots. The method example places its temporary names between bars after the message pattern, and the text explicitly initializes every temporary to nil.

challenge.method: Compare the printed method declaration and nil sentence with the interactive-selection example on printed pp. 51–52.
challenge.results: The initial method temporary binding is nil. A workspace-style immediate evaluation can use similar bar notation under a separately described evaluation extent. The narrow initial-method-state proposition leaves escaping blocks, later activations and storage management open.

limitations: This is the initial state and declaration of an ordinary method temporary. Continuations, escaped blocks, and storage reclamation are separate topics.
